sections.title: Effective Nutrition Counseling and Health Education Skills
sections.description: This online asynchronous course is designed to prepare future healthcare professionals on gaining effective nutrition counseling and health education skills. The essence of the course entails theory and application for promoting effective behavior change and cultural humility while addressing health care bias. Each session builds sequentially on the skills from each preceding session. The culmination of these skills will allow students to effectively develop skills for the role as nutrition counselor or health educator.
